brief.purpose: A local-first co-creative studio where designers and frontend builders work with AI to turn rough product ideas into editable, runnable interfaces
brief.concept: Build an unmistakable lowercase d monogram directly from three collaborating parts: a confident vertical stem, an open rounded bowl, and one small ignition cut or inserted facet where they meet. The d is the Draftly brand initial; the separate colored parts express human, design system, and AI collaborating, while the ignition detail expresses inspiration and a draft becoming real. This is a monogram, not a text label. Do not add the full word, any other letter, document, browser window, robot, cursor, code bracket, chat bubble, flower, pinwheel, or generic four-point AI sparkle
brief.style: Ownable contemporary brand logo with a clearly readable lowercase d silhouette; energetic, creative, welcoming, and precise. Compact flat-vector geometry using two or three bold interlocking color fields, strong one-color fallback, clear at 16 px, memorable from a quick glance. No illustration scene, gradients, gloss, texture, thin lines, tiny details, shadows, enclosing app tile, or mockup
brief.palette: creative violet #6C4DFF, clear sky blue #39BDF8, warm tangerine #FF7849, optional deep ink #20202A; no green
